'''Brian Taylor''' is an artist credited on [[Players Committee]] [[Virtual cards]] for the image on one card, The Empire Knows We're Here / Prepare For Ground Assault in [[Virtual Set 22]], released 2 October 2023.<ref name="cardlabels-0bc4377d9">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/resources/card_labels.json card_labels.json] in billbisco/swccg-gemp (commit 0bc4377d9): the printed labels of every Players Committee Virtual card, transcribed from the PC's card images (res.starwarsccg.org). Field definitions: [https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/docs/card_labels.md docs/card_labels.md].</ref> The credit names his website, candykiller.com. He is not the 2007 Illinois State Championship player of the same name (see [[Brian Taylor]]).

== Card credits ==
One card in all (Image: 1).<ref name="cardlabels-0bc4377d9" /> The table gives the card, its set and the set's release date, and the credit exactly as printed. The same credit is listed under [[Card Credits#Brian Taylor|Brian Taylor]] on the Card Credits page.<ref name="cardcredits">[[Card Credits]], SWCCG Wiki (generated from card_labels.json at commit 0bc4377d9).</ref>
